cautions_and_unresolved_claims.finding: This research did not establish a manufacturer-issued serial-to-manufacturing-year formula or a verified annual serial interval table for Skyjack scissor lifts.
cautions_and_unresolved_claims.applies_to: All scoped Skyjack scissor families; no inference about whether unpublished factory records exist.

cautions_and_unresolved_claims.finding: The public client labels a Machine Info field Production Year, but module 9231 derives the displayed year from machineInfo.in_service_date, falling back to machineInfo.shipped_on.
cautions_and_unresolved_claims.evidence_method: Static source inspection of the current public JavaScript bundle. No real machine lookup was performed.
cautions_and_unresolved_claims.required_followup: Ask Skyjack to confirm the data definitions and whether exact factory manufacture dates are accessible before mapping this value to manufacture_year. No outreach sent.

cautions_and_unresolved_claims.finding: A yyymm/nnnnn serial date rule appears in the service manual, with 20811 meaning November 2008. The source explicitly identifies this as the SKYCODED module serial number.
cautions_and_unresolved_claims.reason: A controller component can predate machine assembly or be replaced; the manual supplies no machine-year equivalence.

cautions_and_unresolved_claims.finding: Technical Publications provides model/serial-specific documents, serial applicability and last-modified metadata. These are documentation dates and parts/configuration breaks, not annual manufacturing cutoffs.
The 14 April 2020 tech tip announces new serial numbers and SJ designation for updated ANSI/SAIA DC scissors. It does not state exact manufacture dates for serials or a serial-year formula.
An OSHA citation associates SJIII 3219 serial 22018949 with manufacture in 2009, but elsewhere in the same text renders the serial as 220189498.
cautions_and_unresolved_claims.reason: Do not silently fix a serial typo or extend one machine observation to an interval.

lookup_workflow.serial_only_result: Manufacturing year not established. Use plate or manufacturer confirmation.
steps: Capture full model and full serial verbatim, plus the whole manufacturer identification plate and any adjacent manufactured-date label. Preserve leading zeroes and A/C/M prefix letters.
Use Skyjack Technical Publications with exact model/serial and region to find the applicable manual and label-location diagram.
Read explicit date fields from the actual machine, preserving the source label: model_year, manufacture_year/month, or production_date. Never replace one field with another implicitly.
Store the photo or manufacturer response, exact serial, date semantics, source URL or evidence ID, and verification date. Machine-specific evidence permits an exact match only.
If missing, illegible, contradictory or out of scope, leave manufacturing year unresolved. Skyjack Product Support is a verified escalation route; obtain user approval before contacting them.
ELEVATE Live may corroborate serial/model/resources. Its current Production Year field is not accepted here as a manufacturing date because of the in-service/shipped-date derivation.

Never extrapolate years from numeric ordering, manual-revision dates, catalog last-modified dates, launch announcements, model numbers, controller serials, engine date codes, invoice dates or warranty start dates.
suggested_confirmation_questions: For this exact machine model and full serial, what are the factory manufacture month/year and model year, separately?
Is there a published serial-to-year table or public supported lookup for these scissor families?
In ELEVATE Live, does Production Year represent in-service date, shipment date, model year, or factory manufacture date?
